messages:
maria: Heads-up — product asked for a quick 'Routing Insights' dashboard for next week's exec demo. Needs these runtime inputs: `route_decisions.count`, `route_latency.p50/p99`, `kv_cache.hit_rate`, and `batch.size.distribution`. Can platform/runtime teams sync on exporter + aggregation plan?

anand: we can emit `route_decisions` and `route_latency` from runtime fairly easily, names above look fine. kv cache hit rate requires a small counter for hits and lookups; prefer `kv_cache.hits` + `kv_cache.lookups` so we can compute ratio in the pipeline.

kevin: for aggregation windows — do we want 1m/5m/1h? Dashboards will show both realtime and 1h trend. 1m and 1h should be enough; 5m adds cost.

sara: retention question: product wants 12 months of trend for execs. We should keep high-cardinality raw samples for 30d, then roll to aggregated (per-hour) for 12mo. Backfill cost for full 30d raw -> hourly aggregate estimate ~ 6 spot GPU hours + ~200GB network egress (ballpark).

julia: console UX note — the dashboard will want both "by-route" breakout and global rollup. If runtime emits route tag as `route` label we can auto-populate route dropdown. Also want an option to hide low-traffic routes.

maria: ok ownership? runtime team to add counters/exporter, eng-platform to add aggregation/retention jobs and dashboard panels. Timeline: 3 business days for runtime changes, 2 days for pipeline + dashboard templating?

anand: can do runtime PR in 2-3 days. I'll add counters + example prometheus metrics and a sample OTLP span tag for route. PR link when ready: https://redwood.internal/pulls/4851

kevin: platform side — I'll scope an aggregation job: hourly rollup job (map-reduce across exporters) + a 7-day fast-path for 1m metrics in TSDB. Will spike cost and we should gate by a feature flag.

sara: feature flags + retention config sound good. For backfill, recommend a dedicated backfill job in kbatch that reads raw bucket -> writes aggregates, with throttling. I'll draft runbook and cost estimate.

maria: action items: 1) @anand add `kv_cache.hits` and `kv_cache.lookups` + route tag; 2) @kevin add hourly aggregator + 1m fast-path; 3) @sara draft backfill runbook + cost; 4) @julia dashboard panels + dropdown logic. Can everyone ack?

anand: ack — starting today.

kevin: ack. I'll create ticket INF-4387 and a rough DAG.

sara: ack, will post runbook and cost estimate by EOD tomorrow.

julia: ack, will mock panels and wire data queries after the aggregator is up.

maria: thanks — one more: please ensure label cardinality is limited (route names truncated to 64 chars, no query params). We'll enforce in runtime.
